answer: For agents trading wharf traffic, vine disease and tundra weather data, cap the total trading subsidy at one coin per sale while burning a two-coin settlement fee. A signed sale ID can claim only once, and no account receives a signup bonus. An attacker controlling both buyer and seller can recycle the sale price, but cannot recover the burned fee: each sham sale loses at least one coin regardless of how many aliases participate. Real sales can justify the fee through useful data; fake turnover cannot sustain itself.
